Context & provenance

About this edition.

Mashyakhat Ibn Tahman, presented in Arabic and English in the order of the source.

The edition

  • TextMashyakhat Ibn Ṭahmān
  • CompilerIbrāhīm ibn Ṭahmān (d. 168 AH)
  • EditionAcademy of the Arabic Language, Damascus, 1403 AH / 1983 CE
  • EditorMuhammad Tahir Malik
  • TransmittersTransmission paths run from the earliest named authority to the compiler, as the source lists them.
  • Extent208 narrations

How the text is presented

Numbering

Shamela states that its numbering matches the printed edition; edition page numbers below come from the page markers inside the text.

Structure of the work

A mashyakha: a list of hadiths Ibn Tahman narrates from his teachers, numbered 1-208 in this edition. Each report is given only from the teacher onward, so every chain here starts with Ibn Tahman's teacher and ends with the earliest named authority; Ibn Tahman himself is listed as the compiler at the end of each path. The text has no chapter headings.

English translation

The English is the supplied bilingual translation. The source file names no translator. Notes that the translation file attaches to a report appear beneath it, apart from the Arabic and English text.

Arabic text

The Arabic is shown as supplied in the clean text of the source file, where written-out honorific formulas are replaced by Unicode symbols. The file also keeps the unaltered wording of every report.

Flags and notes

Source flags mark uncertainties the source records for a report, such as a lacuna, an unnamed transmitter, or a doubt over a name. They describe the text and are not judgments of authenticity. Footnotes, attached remarks, and editor material are listed apart from the report text.

The opening and closing material

Title pages, the chain through which the copy was transmitted, and notes that frame the text are kept here. They are not counted among the narrations.

01   Transmission of the copy Read full text ↓

The distinguished shaykh Abu al-Ma'ali 'Abd Allah b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ahmad b. Sabir al-Sulami informed us, by the reading of my father, may God sanctify his spirit, who said to him: The noble Abu al-Qasim 'Ali b. Ibrahim b. al-'Abbas al-Husayni informed you, in the year 508 [AH]; 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Ahmad al-Kattani informed us; Abu al-Hasan Muhammad b. 'Awf b. Ahmad b. 'Awf informed us, by reading to him; Abu al-Qasim al-Fadl b. Ja'far al-Mu'adhdhin informed us, by reading to him; Abu Bakr Muhammad b. 'Abdus al-Naysaburi narrated to us in al-Ramla; Ahmad b. Hafs b. 'Abd Allah b. Rashid al-Naysaburi narrated to us; my father narrated to us; Ibrahim b. Tahman narrated to me:

أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ أَبُو الْمَعَالِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ صَابِرٍ السُّلَمِيُّ، بِقَرَاءَةِ وَالِدِي قَدَّسَ اللَّهُ رُوحَهُ قَالَ لَهُ: أَخْبَرَكُمُ الشَّرِيفُ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْعَبَّاسِ الْحُسَيْنِيُّ سَنَةَ ثَمَانٍ وَخَمْسِمِائَةٍ، أَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ الْكِتَّانِيُّ، أَنَا أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَوْفِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَوْفٍ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، أَنَا أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمُؤَذِّنُ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، نا أَبُو بَكْرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنُ عَبْدُوسٍ النَّيْسَابُورِيُّ بِالرَّمْلَةِ، نا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ النَّيْسَابُورِيُّ، نا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ
